Specification: This module is a small test specification about record values, specifically the newer record syntax and its typing constraints. It defines a single top-level operator that constructs a set containing two record values with different field domains and checks that this set is not equal to the empty set. The file comments state that it is testing ill-typed access over new records and that new records do not allow shrinking or expanding the domain, so the specification is primarily a syntactic and typing-oriented regression test rather than a temporal system model.
